normalized_mathematical_statements: For a finite index set S, y:S->R, and mu:R, max over f:S->{-1,1} of |sum_i f(i)y(i)+mu| equals sum_i |y(i)|+|mu|.
If a finite relaxed vertex family contains, for each coordinate i, two vertices with difference 2e_i, then it affinely spans R^m.

residual_gap: The generic affine-span reduction is kernel-checked, but the paper-specific construction of relaxed vertices whose coordinate differences span the measurement space remains unproved.
